# Compiler and flags
CC = gcc
CFLAGS = -Wall -g

# Target names
TARGET_ASSIGN3 = test_assign3
TARGET_EXPR = test_expr
TARGET_TOMBSTONE = test_tombstone

# Source files for the targets
SRCS_ASSIGN3 = test_assign3_1.c storage_mgr.c buffer_mgr.c record_mgr.c dberror.c expr.c rm_serializer.c
SRCS_EXPR = test_expr.c storage_mgr.c buffer_mgr.c record_mgr.c dberror.c expr.c rm_serializer.c
SRCS_TOMBSTONE = test_expr.c storage_mgr.c buffer_mgr.c record_mgr.c dberror.c expr.c rm_serializer.c

# Object files (automatically generated from SRCS)
OBJS_ASSIGN3 = $(SRCS_ASSIGN3:.c=.o)
OBJS_EXPR = $(SRCS_EXPR:.c=.o)
OBJS_TOMBSTONE = $(SRCS_TOMBSTONE:.c=.o)

# Include directories (if needed)
INCLUDES = -I.

# Default target: build both binaries
all: $(TARGET_ASSIGN3) $(TARGET_EXPR) $(TARGET_TOMBSTONE)

# Compile test_assign3
$(TARGET_ASSIGN3): $(OBJS_ASSIGN3)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o $(TARGET_ASSIGN3) $(OBJS_ASSIGN3) $(INCLUDES)

# Compile test_expr
$(TARGET_EXPR): $(OBJS_EXPR)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o $(TARGET_EXPR) $(OBJS_EXPR) $(INCLUDES)
	
# Compile test_tombstone
$(TARGET_TOMBSTONE): $(OBJS_TOMBSTONE)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o $(TARGET_TOMBSTONE) $(OBJS_TOMBSTONE) $(INCLUDES)

# Pattern rule for object files
%.o: %.c
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< $(INCLUDES)

# Clean target to remove binaries and object files
clean:
	rm -f $(OBJS_ASSIGN3) $(OBJS_EXPR) $(TARGET_ASSIGN3) $(TARGET_EXPR) $(TARGET_TOMBSTONE)
